Your [[Charr]] allies need explosive materials for their [[Siege Devourer (NPC)|Siege Devourers]]. Head into the [[Ooze Pit]] in order to obtain some.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Recover some [[Prismatic Gelatinous Material|prismatic gelatinous material]] from the ooze pit.
* Transport the prismatic gelatinous material to [[Seer Fiercereign]].

===Reward===
*5,000 [[Experience]]
*1,250 [[Gold]]

== Walkthrough ==

After accepting the quest from Seer Fiercereign, [[map travel|map]] to [[Longeye's Ledge]] and head for the [[Ooze Pit]] in [[Grothmar Wardowns]]. Your [[party]] can fight its way there or a single character can [[run]] there by carefully waiting out the [[patrol]]s along the way (go east from Longeye's, cross the bridge, and then head south to the [[dungeon]]).

Nearly every [[foe]] in the pit is a [[jelly]], each of which can deal powerful [[area of effect]] (AoE) [[damage]]. Many of the jellies will split into two identical foes using [[Ooze Division]]: each new foe has the same [[build]] as the parent, but half the [[health]]; this makes them easier to kill, but allows [[mob]]s to deal twice as much damage. Be careful to keep spread out or use a [[tank]] to ball up the oozes away from the party. Beware of the rolling [[boulder]]s that appear at several locations in the dungeon.

At the beginning, the route is obvious: go west briefly and then head north until you get to the first [[pressure plate]]. (You can leave it closed while tackling the oozes on the other side.) Once through the gate, you need to kill [[Gloop]] to get the [[Boss Key]]. There are several possible routes to Gloop, some of which require opening a gate via another pressure plate and some which require breaking down [[Cracked Wall]]s with [[Unstable Gelatinous Material]], a [[bundle]] dropped by some of the dungeon's jellies.

If you follow [[:File:Watch it Jiggle map.jpg|the route on the map]] (which bypasses the second pressure plate and second gate), you will approach Gloop from the north and requires a Unstable Gelatinous Material to break down a Cracked Wall. [[Pull]] and destroy the nearby oozes before tackling that boss; several can be pulled one at a time or in pairs but there is one larger group. Gloop can be pulled without engaging the four Oozes behind the boss. If you approach Gloop from the southeast (via the second gate using the second pressure plate), you can pull Gloop without having to deal with any other foes. Afterward, retrace your steps and then head to the [[Boss Lock]] to reach the final room in the dungeon.

The end-battle requires defeating three [[Prismatic Ooze]]s, each of which [[spawn]]s around a dozen new oozes when it dies. In addition, the [[boss-like foe]]s use [[Gelatinous Absorption]] to turn [[damage]] into healing.
* Pre-cast protections and enchantments before aggroing the group.
* Focus on one ooze at a time; call the target to make this easier players and so that [[hero]]es and [[henchmen]] react more quickly.
* Switch targets as soon as you notice an ooze start to heal quickly.
* After each Prismatic Ooze dies, you have a few seconds to regroup or retreat to prevent getting overwhelmed by the jellies that spawn afterward.

Killing the third Prismatic Ooze will cause the [[Prismatic Chest]] to spawn, which will drop the Prismatic Gelatinous Material that Seer Fiercereign requested.

=== Skill recommendations ===
* Avoid [[skill]]s that inflict or require [[bleeding]], [[disease]] or [[poison]], or exploit [[corpse]]s:
** The only [[fleshy]] creatures in the dungeon are [[Albino Rat]]s and a very few [[Stormcloud Incubus|Stormcloud Incubii]] (only one [[popup]] group will be encountered when following the route on [[:File:Watch it Jiggle map.jpg|the map provided above]]).
** In addition, [[Ominous Ooze]]s can steal [[minion]]s using [[Verata's Aura]] and [[Shimmering Ooze]]s use [[Spiritual Pain]]. 
* Bring skills that can bypass Gelatinous Absorption, i.e. those that cause [[health degeneration]] or [[health loss]] instead of damage. [[Spoil Victor]] is especially effective here, due to the high [[health]] of the boss-like foes.
* Damage reduction skills help prevent [[wipe]]s caused by multiple jellies dealing simultaneous AoE damage:
** [[Pain Inverter]] will often kill a single foe outright.
** Pre-cast [[Shelter]] and/or [[Union]] to keep them out of the [[aggro]]-range of the oozes. 
** [[Armor of Unfeeling]] helps to prevent [[spirit]]s from being destroyed quickly by the various AoE damage skills, such as Spiritual Pain.
** See also: [[Damage reduction#Threshold_damage_reduction|threshold damage reduction skills]].
* [[Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support]] can be used to ball up foes and to dispose of [[Volatile Ooze]]s (those jellies will waste their [[Unstable Ooze Explosion]] on the summon).
* [["Can't Touch This!"]] can prevent the use of Unstable Ooze Explosion and other touch skills (such as [[Headbutt]] used by [[Aggressive Ooze]]s and [[Ancient Ooze]], and [[Vile Touch]] used by Ominous Oozes) on your [[party]] members.
* If your party does not bring "Can't Touch This!", consider bringing skills that transfer conditions among foes (i.e. [[Epidemic]], [[Extend Conditions]] or [[Fevered Dreams]]) to transfer [[daze]] from Aggressive Oozes' Headbutt to the ooze spellcasters in its proximity.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Seer Fiercereign
:''"[[Pyre Fierceshot|Pyre]] charged me with guarding our base and overseeing the siege weapons.  The problem is, we're extremely low on ammunition!  I've been using gelatinous material from the [[jelly|oozes]] inhabiting a nearby cave. That stuff is nasty. It sticks to everything and burns forever. I love to watch it burn....  Anyway, it's nearly impossible to transport the gelatinous material of the average ooze without disaster. I lost a lot of troops trying. But we finally found one type of ooze that works fairly well. The prismatic form is stable enough to move most of the time. Bring me gelatinous material from prismatic oozes. Then I should be able to cause a ruckus."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Time to get sticky!
|decline = What do you mean by "most of the time"?
|ask = Bring me the gelatinous material from prismatic oozes.  It's the perfect ammo for my siege equipment. 
|indent = :: }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
Anytime one goes near a cracked wall:
:'''<Party leader>:''' ''"[[Unstable Gelatinous Material|Unstable material]] from the oozes should blast this open."''

When one goes near a pressure plate:
:'''<Party leader>:''' ''"It looks like this pressure plate is hooked to some sort of door mechanism."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Seer Fiercereign
:''"Ah, just what I needed. I'm impressed, [[human]]. You're not dead. Well done. In a race of mostly worthless creatures, I suppose there must be one or two exceptions. Here, I've filled this barrel with some of the ooze. Load the siege weapon and hold on to your entrails!"''

==Notes==
*Letting the timer run out, after all players open the chest, returns the party to [[Dalada Uplands]] next to Seer Fiercereign.
*If someone in your party doesn't have the quest, Seer Fiercereign won't appear in the Dalada Uplands, so you won't be able to claim your reward.
*When Seer Fiercereign ''does'' appear, anyone can claim the reward if they have the quest item, regardless of whether they completed the [[dungeon]].
**This can give easy experience for the [[Survivor]] title track. Simply getting the gelatin via [[trade]] and turning it in gives lots of experience without risk of death.

==Trivia==
*Seer's reference to the jelly's ooze sticking to everything and burning forever could be a reference to [[w:Napalm|napthenic and palmitic acids]], the thickening agent used to coagulate ordinary [[w:gasoline|gasoline]] into a jelly substance, making it more difficult to remove.
*The quest name is likely a reference to the old Jello commercials of the 80's.
